name: Khaptad National Park
description: One of Nepal's most pristine national parks, spread over five districts including Bajhang. Known for Khaptad Lake, Khaptad Baba Ashram, and diverse flora and fauna.

name: Surma Valley
description: A picturesque valley with terraced farmlands and traditional village settlements offering authentic rural Nepal experience.

name: Durga Thali
description: A scenic hilltop meadow with panoramic views of the Himalayan range including Api and Saipal peaks.

name: Khaptad Baba Ashram
description: Sacred hermitage of Khaptad Baba, a revered saint. Important pilgrimage site for Hindus and Buddhists alike.

name: Triveni Dham
description: Sacred confluence of three rivers, an important religious site with ancient temples and natural springs.

name: Api Base Camp
description: Base camp for climbing Mount Api (7132m), the highest peak in Far-Western Nepal. Trek through pristine forests.

name: Masta Cave
description: Natural limestone cave with religious significance, featuring stalactites and stalagmites formations.

name: Gyaneshwor Temple
description: Historic temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, situated atop a hill with panoramic valley views.

name: Melauli Lake
description: Crystal clear mountain lake surrounded by alpine meadows and rhododendron forests.

name: Satellite Viewpoint
description: Hilltop viewpoint offering 360-degree views of Bajhang district and surrounding Himalayan ranges.

name: Basuling Church
description: Historic church reflecting the cultural diversity of Bajhang, built in traditional architecture style.

name: Lamabagar Waterfall
description: Majestic waterfall cascading down rocky cliffs surrounded by lush green vegetation.

name: Saipal Viewpoint
description: Spectacular viewpoint offering close views of Mount Saipal (7031m) and surrounding peaks.

name: Traditional Village
description: Heritage village showcasing traditional Far-Western Nepal architecture, customs, and lifestyle.

name: Khaptad Phatante Lake
description: Sacred lake within Khaptad National Park, important for religious rituals and biodiversity.

name: Chhinga Cave
description: Ancient cave formation with mythological importance, located near Thantibazaar.

name: Meshamkhola Bridge
description: Historic suspension bridge over Mesham River, offering scenic river and valley views.

name: Pandava Cave
description: Legendary cave believed to be associated with the Pandavas from Mahabharata.

name: Sudurpaschim View Tower
description: Observation tower with telescopes for viewing distant Himalayan peaks and Bajhang landscape.

name: Surkhet Corridor Trek Start
description: Starting point for the scenic trek connecting Bajhang to Surkhet through diverse terrain.
